metadata.title: Closed geodesics on compact semi-Riemannian manifolds
metadata.abstract: We study the existence of closed geodesics on compact quotients of Lie groups endowed with left-invariant pseudo-Riemannian metrics. We construct a compact, geodesically complete pseudo-Riemannian manifold that admits no closed geodesics. We also establish the existence of closed geodesics in several settings, with particular focus on the Lorentzian case.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 构造六维紧且测地完备、签名 (2,4) 的伪黎曼流形，没有非恒定闭测地线。模型为 Sol×Euc 上两个完备 Lorentz 左不变度量的直积及适当不可约余紧格商；这并未回答完备紧 Lorentz 流形是否必有闭测地线。
techniques: holonomy locus 与格的相交判据
analysis.breakthrough: 揭示 Riemann 情形的闭测地线存在直觉在不定号设置下的失效。
analysis.limitations: 已读第 1 页定理 1.1 及第 4 节（PDF 第 5–7 页）的构造与论证。完备性和部分辅助判据引用前作，未独立复核所有外部依赖；Lorentz 完备紧情形在本文仍列为问题。AI 披露另见独立核查。
